_about: Machine-readable summary of Tale Forge's theme system (natt/morgon) and backdrop atmosphere. Every value cites its source; 'measured' values come from live captures documented in analysis/06-theming-and-atmosphere.md.

mechanism.toggle_component: ThemeToggle, source/js/390j9gbq0u9ce.js: useSyncExternalStore on window event 'tf-theme-change' (server snapshot 'natt'); useLayoutEffect re-reads localStorage; onClick flips data-theme, writes localStorage, dispatches 'tf-theme-change'
mechanism.other_listeners: glöd canvas scenes re-palette via MutationObserver on body[data-theme] (source/js/2j_-r8q4tgdka.js, 36tbz-w9v-p8v.js)
mechanism.os_preference: ignored: no prefers-color-scheme anywhere in CSS/JS; no <meta name=theme-color>; manifest theme_color/background_color #171232 (source/meta/manifest.webmanifest)
mechanism.load_behaviour: measured: saved theme already applied at readyState 'interactive'; 0 CSS transitions running at load (no flash, no animated switch)

order_back_to_front.draw: radial-gradient(<s> <s> at X% Y%, <colour> 50%, #0000 51%) per star: a hard-edged disc of diameter <s>

switch_motion.backdrop: opacity cross-dissolve of .bg-night and .bg-day; measured 50% at 147 ms, 90% at 311 ms, 99% at 434 ms
switch_motion.toggle_thumb: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.3, 1.2); measured overshoot +4.2 px (4.4%) at ~350-367 ms on desktop (travel 94.6 px)
switch_motion.snaps: gradients (--btn-grad on .btn-primary, .tt-thumb, .hiw-play, .fab), all text-shadows (h1, logo), inline-styled nav pills and language switcher, .cta-microcopy, .hiw-* step copy/kicker/lede/micro/nodes/covers, story-map SVG, .book-sub, .foot border
switch_motion.legibility_dip: measured h1 contrast 11.99:1 -> 1.11:1 at 150 ms -> 13.56:1; lede below 3:1 from ~83 to ~250 ms (derived/theming/crossfade/legibility-during-switch.json)
switch_motion.reduced_motion: starfield animation none; body/.bg/.tt/.tt-thumb/.tt-opt transition none (instant switch) (:2349-2372)

legibility_over_backdrop.scrim_effect_desktop: h1 vs brightest 10% of its backdrop: 3.06:1 without scrim -> 7.35:1 with; lede 1.63:1 -> 4.65:1
legibility_over_backdrop.h1_shadow: natt 0 2px 30px #0c082859 (mean backdrop luminance around glyphs -7%); morgon none
